name: 001-engine-smoke
description: Proves the replay loop end to end: an input triple folds into state and a transcript that are recorded and compared byte for byte. The shared fixture cartridge is written with deliberately unsorted keys, so a regression in canonical key ordering fails here rather than in a subtle way later, and it goes through the loader on the way in, so a world that stops validating fails here too. The events are the smallest thing the reducer can fold: time passing, twice.
